Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity changed how we understand the universe by linking space, time, and gravity. It consists of two parts: special relativity, which is used in particle physics and cosmology, and general relativity, which explains how gravity works. According to this theory, massive objects like planets and stars bend the fabric of space and time around them, and this bending is what we experience as gravity.

The first three months of the year are January, February, and March.
